CustomField.description: AU credit contracts: the loan balance (amount of credit plus fees less principal repaid). Until Sep 2026 this also added 25% of the disclosed interest not yet paid; that loading was removed.
CustomField.formula: IF( Account.State_Master_State__c ='NZ' || !Is_Credit_Contract__c, Remaining_Amount__c , ((Amount- Total_Interest_Amount__c ) + Total_Additional_Fees__c) - Total_Paid_Principal_Amount__c )
CustomField.label: Payout Figure
